conditions.open: Fully open the designated existing closure; other permanent obstructions remain unchanged.
conditions.sealed: Close and tightly seal the designated existing closure, preserving its material/glazing and all other geometry; no air or rain through the sealed closure itself.
conditions.no_closure_policy: If no existing closure or its counterfactual material is unknown, sealed-condition judgments are not determinable; do not invent a closure.
